title: BEA says quarterly GDP is reported at annual rates unless otherwise specified
summary: BEA says quarterly GDP is reported at annual rates unless otherwise specified.
body: BEA says quarterly GDP data are reported at annual rates, for ease of comparison, unless otherwise specified. The source says: "Quarterly GDP data are reported at annual rates , for ease of comparison, unless otherwise specified." An annual rate is not the quarter's own percent change. Reading a quarterly annualized figure as the gain during that quarter alone misreads the unit BEA states.
